state.title: git diff

part.text:
Implemented the fix.

- `lib/adapters/http.js`: When `maxBodyLength <= -1` (axios default), pass `Infinity` to `follow-redirects` instead of letting its 10 MB default apply. This makes the default unlimited consistently for both redirect and non-redirect requests, and makes `maxBodyLength: -1` honored.
- `README.md`: Documented the default `maxBodyLength` as `-1` (unlimited).

Validation: the FAIL_TO_PASS max body length tests pass, along with the other HTTP adapter tests. The only full-suite failures were an external `google.com` HTTPS test and a timing-flaky max-content-length test, both unrelated and passing in isolation.
